panels.title: Security — API server audit (who did what)
Audited requests by verb
panels.description: Every request the audit policy records: all writes, reads by people and by the admin credential. Service account, node and control plane reads are not recorded.

targets.expr: sum by (verb) (count_over_time({namespace="kube-system", container="kube-apiserver"} |= "audit.k8s.io/v1" | json verb="verb", user_username="user.username", objectRef_resource="objectRef.resource", objectRef_subresource="objectRef.subresource", objectRef_namespace="objectRef.namespace", objectRef_name="objectRef.name", responseStatus_code="responseStatus.code" [$__auto]))

panels.title: Denied requests (403) by user
panels.description: Requests refused by RBAC. A burst from one identity usually means it is probing what it may do (alert: AuditForbiddenBurst).

targets.expr: sum by (user) (count_over_time({namespace="kube-system", container="kube-apiserver"} |= "audit.k8s.io/v1" |= `"code":403` | json verb="verb", user_username="user.username", objectRef_resource="objectRef.resource", objectRef_subresource="objectRef.subresource", objectRef_namespace="objectRef.namespace", objectRef_name="objectRef.name", responseStatus_code="responseStatus.code" | responseStatus_code="403" | label_format user="{{.user_username}}" [$__auto]))

panels.title: Changes by user
panels.description: create, update, patch and delete requests over the selected time range.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (user) (count_over_time({namespace="kube-system", container="kube-apiserver"} |= "audit.k8s.io/v1" | json verb="verb", user_username="user.username", objectRef_resource="objectRef.resource", objectRef_subresource="objectRef.subresource", objectRef_namespace="objectRef.namespace", objectRef_name="objectRef.name", responseStatus_code="responseStatus.code" | verb=~"create|update|patch|delete" | label_format user="{{.user_username}}" [$__range])))

panels.title: Security-relevant requests
panels.description: exec, attach and port-forward, secret access, RBAC changes and denied requests: user, verb, resource, namespace/name and response code.

targets.expr: {namespace="kube-system", container="kube-apiserver"} |= "audit.k8s.io/v1" | json verb="verb", user_username="user.username", objectRef_resource="objectRef.resource", objectRef_subresource="objectRef.subresource", objectRef_namespace="objectRef.namespace", objectRef_name="objectRef.name", responseStatus_code="responseStatus.code" | objectRef_subresource=~"exec|attach|portforward" or objectRef_resource="secrets" or (objectRef_resource=~"clusterrolebindings|rolebindings|clusterroles|roles" and verb=~"create|update|patch|delete") or responseStatus_code="403" | line_format "{{.user_username}}  {{.verb}} {{.objectRef_resource}}{{if .objectRef_subresource}}/{{.objectRef_subresource}}{{end}}  {{.objectRef_namespace}}/{{.objectRef_name}}  → {{.responseStatus_code}}"
